# SGEN · Dispensary SEO and AEO

> You cannot buy reach on Google or Meta, so organic is the whole game. SGEN wins the map pack, the menu searches and the AI answers, from $497/mo on monthly terms.

SGEN runs local search for cannabis retailers. Storefronts, delivery services, medical and adult-use. Two things get worked on: rank in Google search, Maps and the cannabis directories, and whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude will quote the shop. Priced as one retainer from $497 a month. No setup, no term.

## Pages
- [Dispensary SEO and AEO](https://www.sgen.com/cannabis-dispensary-local-seo-aeo): the cannabis retail landing page. Method, pricing, proof and FAQ.

## The argument
Nobody searches for a dispensary in the abstract. They search for a product, a deal or a delivery window, and they buy from whoever turns up. The highest-intent pages on a dispensary site are therefore the menu and category pages. On a great many builds those pages are served from a platform subdomain or inside a widget, where they may never be indexed under the shop's own domain, and a badly built age gate can compound it. Getting them crawlable is where this work starts.

## Pricing
- Local SEO · $497/month
- Local AEO · $797/month
- Local SEO + AEO · $1,297/month
All three tiers bill monthly through Stripe, cancellable in the customer portal, with nothing to set up and nothing to sign. Managed Weedmaps and Leafly advertising is the one line quoted apart from the retainer.

## Method
Six stages. Audit and entity mapping, including whether the menu has ever been indexed. Foundation rebuild: schema, llms.txt, structured customer questions, an age gate that does not lock crawlers out, listings brought into line, Core Web Vitals. Content engine at 8 to 24 pages a month. Citation network across city news desks, culture titles and the cannabis directories. Weekly tracking across Google and the four assistants. Then scale into further doors, delivery zones and categories.

## Categories served
Adult-use storefronts, medical dispensaries, hybrids, delivery-only operations, CBD and hemp shops, vape and concentrate specialists, edibles-led retail, pre-roll and flower boutiques, consumption lounges. One door or fifty.

## Key answers
- How long does it take? Google is the slow half: two to four months before the map position moves enough to feel it at the till. Assistant mentions can arrive inside four to eight weeks.
- Can I cancel? Yes, and without speaking to anyone. Stripe bills monthly and the portal has a cancel button. Everything built stays on your domain.
- What is AEO? Getting the shop named when a customer asks an assistant where to buy. Standard SEO fights over ten slots on a page. AEO fights over the reply, of which there is one.
- Why does it matter more in cannabis? Paid search and paid social are shut off to this category, so organic and AI visibility are what is left.
- Is there a contract? No. Rolling monthly.

## Pricing detail
- Local SEO · $497/month. 15 keywords held as primary targets and reported monthly, 4 articles a month split between product and education, page-level work on 5+ pages a month, Business Profile tightened up and maintained, 10 citations a month with Weedmaps and Leafly among them, 3+ backlinks worth having, Store and Product schema shipped and validated, and a performance report at every month end.
- Local AEO · $797/month. 10 prompts under observation across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude, writing aimed at getting quoted rather than merely indexed, 2+ question posts a month built to be lifted, an entity graph put together and the knowledge panel taken over, llms.txt authored with crawler permissions spelled out, schema covering how people phrase things out loud, all four assistants on a single screen, and a performance report at every month end.
- Local SEO + AEO · $1,297/month. Everything above, plus 40+ keywords held as primary targets, 20 prompts under observation, 12 articles and 4+ question posts published monthly, page-level work on 25+ pages a month, an entity graph with the panel and a written AI visibility plan, 40+ citations and 25+ links a month off-site, and up to 6 generated location or category pages a month.
Nothing to join, nothing for onboarding, no add-on you are obliged to buy. Stop paying and the pages, posts, citations and links are still sitting on your domain.

## Method detail
1. Audit and entity mapping. Where the shop stands in Google, whether the menu has ever been indexed, what the assistants currently say about you, and how the shops above you earned their citations. Out of that comes an entity graph covering 14 AI surfaces.
2. Foundation rebuild. Store, Product and OfferCatalog schema, an llms.txt file, structured customer questions, an age gate that does not lock crawlers out, listings brought into line across Google and the directories, and page speed brought within Core Web Vitals.
3. Content engine. Between 8 and 24 pages a month, each one taken from something customers actually type: what a format does, where to start with dose, how two products differ, whether the van comes to their street. Every page laid out so it can be quoted.
4. Citation network. City news desks, culture titles, the cannabis directories worth appearing on, and the community threads, video and other material these models are trained from.
5. Track and iterate. Visibility reported weekly across Google and all four assistants. Anything working takes more of the budget. Anything flat is dropped.
6. Scale. With the trading area secured the reach widens: further doors, delivery zones, additional categories, then voice search and local video.

## What is covered
Twenty-two deliverables in every tier, across four groups. Foundation: a technical review of 140 separate checks including whether the menu is indexable at all, schema, AI access, Core Web Vitals, and listings. Content: product and education pages, local pages per neighbourhood and delivery zone, a question library, keyword focus on product, deal and delivery terms, and schema shaped for how people ask about effects and dosage. Authority: press, directories, communities, entity records and the knowledge panel. Tracking: weekly rankings, four assistants on one screen, attribution for calls, directions taps and pre-orders, competitor monitoring, and one call a month with the person doing the work.

## Timeline
- Day 0. You subscribe. Tier picked, checkout done, receipt in the inbox.
- Same day. A 90 second brief: the trading area and any delivery zone, the categories that carry your margin, which menu platform you run, and what a better quarter would look like. A senior strategist reads it first.
- Within 24 hours. Your 30 day plan arrives. A single named contact, a baseline audit, the order things get built in, and the list of AI prompts we will be measured on.
- Within 7 days. Work starts landing. Profile fixed, directory listings squared up, schema in, first citations lodged, first pages live. Reporting opens the same week.

## What is not offered
- No term, no setup fee, no leaving fee.
- No guaranteed rankings. Two to four months is the normal band for ranking movement, and assistant mentions generally arrive before that.
- No Google or Meta advertising. That channel is closed to this category. Managed Weedmaps and Leafly advertising is available separately.

## The record
500+ dispensaries ranked, from single-door shops through to multi-state operators. $47M+ in client revenue generated. 9+ years in cannabis retail and in local search, with the same bench of people on every account. 4.9 out of 5 across 50+ verified client reviews.
